name: Attila
role: Ruler of the Hunnic Empire from 434 to 453
contribution: The ruler of the Huns from 434 until his death in early 453.

checks.lead: Attila (  ə-TIL-ə or  AT-il-ə; c. 406 – 453), frequently called Attila the Hun and also known by his nickname The Scourge of God, was the ruler of the Huns from 434 until his death in early 453. He was also the leader of an empire consisting of Huns, Ostrogoths, Alans, and Gepids, among others, in Central and Eastern Europe.
